title_zh: 赓续长征精神 奋进复兴征程
title_en: Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit on the Journey to Rejuvenation
summary_zh: 2026年10月22日，纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会举行，习近平发表重要讲话，号召弘扬伟大长征精神、走好新的长征路。
summary_en: On Oct 22, 2026, China held a meeting marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, where Xi Jinping called for carrying forward the Long March spirit and walking the new long march well.
